description: Use when the user wants to know whether Spain Visa Submit suits their situation. Needs three answers: is the application package complete and ready, does the applicant already have a working Spanish digital certificate or Cl@ve, and which procedure. Returns fits or does not fit with plain reasons. It gives no advice on documents, eligibility or visa strategy. It never accepts or reads documents. Uploads, payment and the power of attorney happen only on spainvisasubmit.com.

hasSpanishCertificate.description: True if the applicant already has a working Spanish digital certificate or Cl@ve to file electronically.

language.description: Site language for links, for example "en", "ru" or "es". Defaults to "en".

packageReady.description: True if the application package is complete and ready to submit as it is.

procedure.description: digital_nomad, entrepreneur, corporate_uge (PAC / EU Blue Card, researcher, ICT or audiovisual), other (another UGE-CE procedure) or not_sure.

name: check_fit
title: Check whether the service fits
